exact_statement: Determine how large n must be as a function of r >= 2 so that there is an antichain in 2^[n] occupying n-3 distinct ranks and containing at least r members on every occupied rank.
scope_notes: Round four proves that the fixed K4,r9 orbit has no uniform finite recovery rank.
This round tests whether a finite menu of q-independent lower-tail resets can repair that obstruction before rank 42.
A finite-menu no-go is a route obstruction, not the public antichain theorem; q-dependent or leading-block switches remain outside its scope.
